newsitem.title: USA: Hartford Whalers moving to Raleigh, N.C. - report.
newsitem.headline: Hartford Whalers moving to Raleigh, N.C. - report.

text.p: The Hartford Whalers of the National Hockey League (NHL) will announce later Tuesday that they are moving to Raleigh, N.C., Hartford Courant reported.
A news conference with team and North Carolina officials is scheduled for 1200 EDT Tuesday in Raleigh, the paper said.
A Whalers spokesman could not immediately be reached for comment.
The new team, the Carolina Hurricanes, is expected to play in a new $120 million, 20,000 seat arena, beginning with the 1999-2000 season, according to the report.
The facility will be constructed under supervision of Raleigh's Centennial Authority.
The Whalers had been in Hartford since 1975, and joined the NHL four years later. They were Connecticut's only major league sports franchise.
Hartford business and civic leaders are seeking ways to replace the $73 million a year that the Whalers pumped into the capital city's economy.
